I.value_zh: inventory、SOP、版本和文档资产、release.yml 与 Git 文件清单。
I.value_en: inventory, SOP, version/doc assets, release.yml and Git file list.

O.value_zh: 两脚本、verify 集成、inventory 更新、双语 finding、报告归档。
O.value_en: Two scripts, verify integration, inventory update, bilingual findings, report/archive.

A.value_zh: 实现 R1–R12、漂移扫描、verify 接入、更新和 dry-run。
A.value_en: Implement R1–R12, drift scan, verify wiring, update and dry-run.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 指令，ME 实施，CI 检查。
P.value_en: ADMIN directs, ME implements, CI checks.

R.value_zh: 原文未设执行期限或资源预算；P0/中风险为任务元数据，12 规则、两脚本和三类漂移是交付及验收范围。
R.value_en: No execution deadline or resource budget is stated; P0/medium risk is task metadata, while 12 rules, two scripts and three drift types define deliverable and acceptance scope.
R.notes_zh: dry-run 是发布前验证动作，不是资源配额。
R.notes_en: Dry-run is a pre-release verification action, not a resource quota.

C.value_zh: R1–R12、R2 故障、drift、dry-run、inventory 与循环；验收第 1 条要求在仍对齐 3.0.2 的现状下以 --new 3.0.3 全绿，与 R1/R2 等必须等于 --new 相冲突。
C.value_en: R1–R12, R2 regression, drift, dry-run, inventory and loop; acceptance item 1 requires an all-green --new 3.0.3 run against a current 3.0.2-aligned repository, conflicting with R1/R2 requiring equality to --new.
C.notes_zh: 须澄清验收目标版本或先升级版本文件；不能为通过而改写原文。
C.notes_en: Clarify the acceptance target version or first update versioned files; do not rewrite the source to force a pass.

B.value_zh: 不得加库内 audit、其他 workflow、改 inventory §2、直接 push main 或超范围修复。
B.value_en: Do not add library audit, other workflow, alter inventory §2, push main directly or fix out of scope.
